evals.prompt: I have a 50GB analytics dataset with complex window function queries. Should I use Arrow or DuckDB as my acceleration engine?
evals.expected_output: Recommend DuckDB for medium datasets with complex SQL. Explain Arrow is better for small datasets, DuckDB for complex SQL with memory management.

assertions.name: recommends_duckdb
assertions.description: Should recommend DuckDB for this use case

assertions.name: explains_reasoning
assertions.description: Should explain why DuckDB is better for complex queries

evals.prompt: We're running Spice on an edge device with limited RAM (2GB). We need to accelerate a 5GB dataset. What engine and mode should I use?
evals.expected_output: Use file mode with DuckDB or SQLite to avoid loading everything into RAM

assertions.name: recommends_file_mode
assertions.description: Should recommend file mode for limited RAM

assertions.name: mentions_suitable_engine
assertions.description: Should recommend an engine that supports file mode

evals.prompt: I need to configure DuckDB file-based acceleration and point it at a specific database file path. How do I set that up?
evals.expected_output: Show DuckDB engine config with mode: file and duckdb_file parameter
